description: Apothecary tray — muted shell with SKU-tagged beauty cards in a soft grid (RTL/LTR).

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import bodyButterImg from "./images/body-butter.webp" import bodyLotionImg from "./images/body-lotion.webp" import dryShampooImg from "./images/dry-shampoo.webp" import eyePrimerImg from "./images/eye-primer.webp" import facePrimerImg from "./images/face-primer.webp" import faceWashImg from "./images/face-wash.webp" import hairBrushImg from "./images/hair-brush.webp" import lipstickImg from "./images/lipstick.webp" import nailPolishImg from "./images/nail-polish.webp" import skinGlowImg from "./images/skin-glow.webp" function assetSrc(asset: string | { src: string }) { return typeof asset === "string" ? asset : asset.src } const CATEGORIES = [ { name: "Hair Brush", img: assetSrc(hairBrushImg), sku: "BR-01" }, { name: "Body Lotion", img: assetSrc(bodyLotionImg), sku: "LT-02" }, { name: "Nail Polish", img: assetSrc(nailPolishImg), sku: "NP-03" }, { name: "Body Butter", img: assetSrc(bodyButterImg), sku: "BT-04" }, { name: "Lipstick Category", img: assetSrc(lipstickImg), sku: "LP-05" }, { name: "Eye Primer", img: assetSrc(eyePrimerImg), sku: "EP-06" }, { name: "Dry Shampoo", img: assetSrc(dryShampooImg), sku: "DS-07" }, { name: "Face Wash", img: assetSrc(faceWashImg), sku: "FW-08" }, { name: "Skin Glow", img: assetSrc(skinGlowImg), sku: "SG-09" }, { name: "Face Primer", img: assetSrc(facePrimerImg), sku: "FP-10" }, ] as const export default function ProductCategories({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"section">) { return (

Apothecary tray

Featured Categories

{CATEGORIES.length} formulas

    {CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
  • {category.sku}

    {category.name}

    • ))}
) }
